_comment: JSON-Schema-SUBSET for build_portfolio_emit.py's portfolio-emit.json (BC-12943, ADR-028 Phase-2 Batch B). Validated by scripts/eval/assert_lib.py — supported keywords ONLY: type (name or list; 'null' matches None), required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items, enum, const. Asserts the matrix SHAPE (every row carries the same key set + types). frontmatter/title_label/sections/banners/verdicts/campaigns_in_window are left type-only ([object|string|array|integer, null]) so the golden + golden_compare lock their per-branch values: an OK row carries the projected packet; a rejection row (the anti-creep guard, exit 2) carries null for every report field + a non-null error string.
